title: Stop on provider errors and keep them out of refusal counts.
comment:
**Stop on provider errors and keep them out of refusal counts.**

If `prepareMoment` throws a provider error without setting `ledger.blocked` or `unexpected`, this catch records `invalid` and starts the next sample. The run policy says a provider error stops the run. Also, `tally.mts` Lines 34–36 classify `invalid` and `blocked` rows as evidence refusals. Stop after operational errors, and classify them separately from plan refusals. Based on learnings, goal-driven execution requires verifiable checks against the stated success criteria.

title: Keep operational outcomes out of plan-refusal metrics.
comment:
**Keep operational outcomes out of plan-refusal metrics.**

`sample.mts` records provider failures as `blocked` rows and stops the loop. `tally.mts` currently treats every non-stored row as refused, which can inflate refusal, refusal-cause, false-refusal, and without-review refusal metrics for operational rows. The committed 98 samples contain only `stored` and `refused` outcomes, so the current report is unaffected.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
 const clean = (f: Flags | undefined) => !!f && blockers.every((x) => !f[x]);
 const group = (book: string) => Object.entries(base("plan.json").bookGroups as Record<string, string[]>).find(([, books]) => books.includes(book))![0];
+const isPlanRefusal = (r: { outcome: string }) => r.outcome === "refused";
 const rows = samples.map((s) => {
 ...
-  return { id: s.id, book: s.book, group: group(s.book), stored, cause, accepted: stored && clean(fFinal), flawedStored: stored && !clean(fFinal), falseRefusal: !stored && clean(fFinal),
+  return { id: s.id, book: s.book, group: group(s.book), outcome: s.outcome, stored, cause, accepted: stored && clean(fFinal), flawedStored: stored && !clean(fFinal), falseRefusal: !stored && clean(fFinal),
 ...
-  refused: wilson(rs.filter((r) => !r.stored).length, rs.length),
-  refusedBy: { missingCast: rs.filter((r) => r.cause === "missingCast").length, evidence: rs.filter((r) => r.cause === "evidence").length, review: rs.filter((r) => r.cause === "review").length },
-  falseRefusal: wilson(rs.filter((r) => r.falseRefusal).length, rs.length), replanned: wilson(rs.filter((r) => r.replanned).length, rs.length),
-  withoutReview: { accepted: wilson(rs.filter((r) => r.withoutReview.accepted).length, rs.length), flawedStored: wilson(rs.filter((r) => r.withoutReview.flawedStored).length, rs.length), refused: wilson(rs.filter((r) => !r.withoutReview.stored).length, rs.length) } });
+  refused: wilson(rs.filter(isPlanRefusal).length, rs.length),
+  refusedBy: { missingCast: rs.filter((r) => isPlanRefusal(r) && r.cause === "missingCast").length, evidence: rs.filter((r) => isPlanRefusal(r) && r.cause === "evidence").length, review: rs.filter((r) => isPlanRefusal(r) && r.cause === "review").length },
+  falseRefusal: wilson(rs.filter((r) => isPlanRefusal(r) && r.falseRefusal).length, rs.length), replanned: wilson(rs.filter((r) => r.replanned).length, rs.length),
+  withoutReview: { accepted: wilson(rs.filter((r) => r.withoutReview.accepted).length, rs.length), flawedStored: wilson(rs.filter((r) => r.withoutReview.flawedStored).length, rs.length), refused: wilson(rs.filter((r) => isPlanRefusal(r) && !r.withoutReview.stored).length, rs.length) } });
```
